snippet.title: Dadi Kingdom | Official Gameplay Trailer | Early Access December 7, 2026
snippet.description:
You wear the crown. Judge the accused in your throne room, then take the sword and defend what is yours.

Dadi Kingdom is a medieval action RPG where you rule and fight. Every day new cases land before your throne: release, gold fine or dungeon. Your verdicts follow you. Outside the walls, the kingdom waits: the Far Lands, the cathedral of Sanktum, the desert bastion, the pirate bay, the ash forests and the mage ruins of Thyrn. Stone golems, lizardmen and dark mages stand in your way.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4166450

Early Access starts December 7, 2026.
Available in 13 languages.

Everything in this trailer is real gameplay, captured in the current build.

Website: https://dadi-kingdom.de
Discord: https://discord.gg/WbV4JbSEvq
